description: Module-level mutable state that stays at module scope in apps/canvas/src and packages/shell/src, one reason per name (scripts/instance-guard.mjs; docs/composable-editor-plan.md, E1). Everything an editor keeps lives in its instance (apps/canvas/src/app/instance.tsx) or its scope (packages/shell/src/state/editor-scope.tsx); what is listed here is the page's by nature, or is keyed by a per-editor object so it is per editor by construction. A new entry needs the same: say why two editors on one page may share it.

apps/canvas/src/panels/journal-panel.tsx.view: A memo of the page's one journal (journal-sink.ts), keyed by the journal's version: derived from page state, holds nothing of an editor.

apps/canvas/src/panels/catalog-registry..singleton: The catalog of leaf renderers the schema panels compose from: filled once with the same built-in entries and never changed after, so every editor on the page reads the same immutable table.

apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.connection: The live relay (ADR 225) connects a TAB to paged.server, not an editor in it: one relay per page. It acts on the editor that connected it (`editor`).
apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.ask: The page's live relay setting, 'Ask before each change' (see `connection`).
apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.pending: The page's live relay questions waiting for an answer (see `connection`).
apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.version: The page's live relay version counter (see `connection`).
apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.editor: The scope of the editor that connected the page's relay (see `connection`); set by `connect`.
apps/canvas/src/live-bridge.ts.listeners: Subscribers to the page's live relay (see `connection`).

apps/canvas/src/journal-sink.ts.workerEpochMs: The journal (ADR 025) is the page's: one bug report for the page, capturing everything that happened in it, whichever editor it happened in.
apps/canvas/src/journal-sink.ts.drainer: The page's journal drains the worker of the editor that registered last; an editor's unregister clears only its own (setJournalDrainer).
apps/canvas/src/journal-sink.ts.documentShapeProvider: The page's journal reports the shape of the document of the editor that registered last; an editor's unregister clears only its own.
apps/canvas/src/journal-sink.ts.loadedPlugins: The page's journal roster of the bundles loaded on the page (the same bundles in every editor of a build).

apps/canvas/src/object-commands.ts.NUDGE_QUEUES: A WeakMap keyed by the editor's engine client: one queue per engine, so per editor by construction, and dropped with the client.

apps/canvas/src/clipboard-commands.ts.seq: The page-item clipboard is the page's, like the system clipboard it mirrors: copy in one editor, paste in another.

packages/shell/src/demo/overlay.tsx.current: The live-demo playground's overlay (the dev and demo builds' guided demo): one guide per page, driven by the page's demo script.
packages/shell/src/demo/overlay.tsx.subscribers: Subscribers to the page's demo overlay (see `current`).
packages/shell/src/demo/overlay.tsx.guideSideSubs: Subscribers to the page's demo guide placement (see `current`).
packages/shell/src/demo/overlay.tsx.spotlightSubs: Subscribers to the page's demo spotlight (see `current`).

packages/shell/src/catalog/property-fiel.engineReads: A memo of what the engine build reads: every editor on the page runs the same engine wasm, so an answer holds for all of them.

packages/shell/src/state/document-loader.defaultFontUrls: Where the build serves its default faces: set once by the build that ships them (the editor package), the same for every editor on the page.
packages/shell/src/state/document-loader.defaultItalic: A cache of the default italic face's bytes, fetched once for the page and handed to every editor.

packages/shell/src/state/content-selecti.heldBy: A WeakMap keyed by the editor's engine client: each editor's held typing style, per editor by construction.

packages/shell/src/state/editor-scope.ts.detached: The one scope of components rendered outside any editor (a standalone panel, a unit test). Every editor mount provides its own scope.

packages/shell/src/state/document-source.sources: A WeakMap keyed by the File object a picker read: the source travels with the file into whichever editor opens it.

packages/shell/src/ai/availability.ts.availability: Whether the page's origin answers the AI proxy: a fact about the page's server, the same for every editor on it.
packages/shell/src/ai/availability.ts.probe: The page's one probe of the AI proxy (see `availability`).
packages/shell/src/ai/availability.ts.listeners: Subscribers to the page's AI availability (see `availability`).

packages/shell/src/ai/editor-ai.ts.catalogLoad: A cache of the scripting API catalogue the build ships: fetched once for the page, the same for every editor.

packages/shell/src/icons/Icon.tsx.warnedUnknownIcons: Warn-once bookkeeping for the console: an unknown icon name is a build problem, said once per page.

packages/shell/src/lib/file-chooser.ts.pending: The transient file inputs a picker is waiting on, each settled by its own change event: page DOM, owned by the pick that made it, gone when it settles.

packages/shell/src/state/editor-root.tsx.active: Which editor gets the keys typed with nothing focused (the page's <body>): the one last pointed at or focused, or the one that owns the page. The page has one keyboard, so this is the page's by nature.
packages/shell/src/state/editor-root.tsx.roots: The editors' roots on the page, each with whether it owns the page: what decides which editor a key on the page belongs to. The page's by nature, like `active`.

packages/shell/src/registries/presentati.sessionSeq: Numbers a presentation's BroadcastChannel and audience window, which are the page's (a channel name is shared by the whole origin): one counter per page keeps two editors' presentations on one page from opening the same channel.
